stories.headline: Dylan Sprouse's shady Jared Leto tweets resurfaces amid sexual assault allegations - Page Six
stories.summary: Multiple women have accused the actor-musician of sexual misconduct, with many claiming they were underage at the time.
stories.why: This signals how quickly celebrity moral reckoning can flip—if Sprouse was calling out Leto's behavior while Leto faced allegations, it exposes the performative activism guys your age grew up seeing on Twitter.

stories.headline: 9 Albums Out This Week You Should Listen to Now - pitchfork.com
stories.summary: Also stream new releases from Arca and Davido
stories.why: Arca and Davido represent the shift from genre gatekeeping to algorithmic discovery; which albums you engage with signals your taste identity in ways your dad's vinyl collection never did.

stories.headline: After ‘Brand New Day,’ It’s Clear The MCU Will Have Two Spider-Men Soon - Forbes
stories.summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is breaking records, and as such, it is clear that Sony and Marvel are about to throw a second Spider-Man into the mix, based on recent comments.
stories.why: Two Spider-Men means Marvel is cannabilizing its own IP to chase streaming numbers—a sign the franchise model that defined your 20s is fracturing into desperation plays.

stories.headline: Sadie Sink’s ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ character officially revealed - Entertainment Weekly
stories.summary: Sadie Sink’s ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ character officially revealed as film opens in theaters.
stories.why: Sadie Sink in Spider-Man is the industry betting that Gen Z female stars can anchor tentpoles the way male actors always could; it's a real shift in who Hollywood thinks will drive box office.

stories.headline: ‘I Want Your Sex’: The Year’s Wildest Sex Scene Will Knock Your Socks Off - The Daily Beast
stories.summary: Olivia Wilde and Cooper Hoffman engage in a truly unforgettable sex scene montage.
stories.why: An R-rated sex scene getting awards buzz signals a brief window where prestige cinema still competes with streaming—relevant if you still care whether films hit theaters or your couch.

stories.headline: Inside the underhive – The art of Necromunda’s new edition - Warhammer Community
stories.summary: Check out some of the fantastic new artwork from the Necromunda Core Rulebook.
stories.why: Necromunda's resurgence reflects how Games Workshop pivoted to high-production hobby content for guys who aged out of video games into collectible community; it's a parallel economy emerging.

stories.headline: Apple TV’s Cape Fear remake turns it into a paranoid tech thriller - The Verge
stories.summary: Cape Fear on Apple TV updates the classic revenge film with technological upgrades like drones and AI.
stories.why: Updating Cape Fear with drones and AI paranoia signals how every 90s revenge thriller is being retrofitted for post-Snowden anxiety—the threat landscape of your childhood no longer resonates.

stories.headline: Stuart Fails To Save The Universe Episode 2 Surprises With Another Big Bang Theory Legacy Cast Member — Plus, A Last Name Mystery Solved? - TVLine
stories.summary: The cast and creators of Big Bang Theory spin-off Stuart Fails to Save the Universe discuss the shocking return of another original cast member in Episode 2.
stories.why: Big Bang Theory nostalgia spinoffs mean your comfort media is now generating content; it's either comforting or a sign you're being mined for IP dollars rather than being told new stories.
